title: Encore of Ep. 45: What Are The Odds?

sentences.en: A couple of months ago, we asked you to share coincidences you've experienced.
sentences.zh: 几个月前，我们邀请大家分享你们经历过的巧合。

sentences.en: Lots of you called in with amazing stories.
sentences.zh: 许多听众打来电话，分享了精彩的故事。

sentences.en: Nestled among them were two stories that themselves formed a coincidence.
sentences.zh: 在这其中，有两段故事本身就构成了又一个巧合。

sentences.en: So I was a student at the University of Rhode Island, and we were in this writing class.
sentences.zh: 当时我是罗德岛大学的学生，我们在一堂写作课上。

sentences.en: She was talking to the teacher of her writing class,
sentences.zh: 当时她正在跟写作课老师说话，

sentences.en: and the teacher mentioned that she lived in a small town in Vermont.
sentences.zh: 老师提到她住在佛蒙特州的一个小镇上。

sentences.en: The same small town, it turned out, where Amanda's mother had grown up.
sentences.zh: 结果发现，那正是阿曼达的母亲长大的那个小镇。

sentences.en: The teacher asked Amanda what her mother's maiden name was, and Amanda told her.
sentences.zh: 老师问阿曼达她母亲婚前的姓氏是什么，阿曼达告诉了她。

sentences.en: She just kind of drops her pen, and she goes,
you're not going to believe this, but I live in the house where your mother grew up.
sentences.zh: 你可能不会相信，但我住的房子就是你妈妈长大的地方。

sentences.en: The other listener who called us was Sarah Toperoff.
sentences.zh: 另一位给我们打电话的听众是萨拉·托佩罗夫。

sentences.en: She called us on a scratchy phone line from Paris.
sentences.zh: 她通过一条杂音很重的电话线从巴黎打来。

sentences.en: Sarah's an American, but has been living in France for several years.
sentences.zh: 萨拉是个美国人，但在法国已经住了好几年。

sentences.en: She was at a house party, and someone there told her that there was another American in the room.
sentences.zh: 她当时正在参加一个家庭派对，有人告诉她房间里还有另一个美国人。

sentences.en: So she went over to say hello.
So it turns out I met at this house party in Paris,
sentences.zh: 结果我在这场巴黎的派对上遇到的人，

sentences.en: grew up in the exact same house in Poughkeepsie, New York, as my father.
sentences.zh: 和我父亲在纽约州波基普西市长大时住的是同一栋房子。

sentences.en: We thought we might find out.
This week, we'll talk about the mathematics of coincidences.
sentences.zh: 本周，我们将探讨巧合背后的数学原理。

sentences.en: That particular kind of coincidence, meeting an acquaintance or somebody you're familiar with,
sentences.zh: 那种特定类型的巧合——在极其陌生的地方遇到熟人或认识的人，

sentences.en: in a very strange place, I would say perhaps 80% of all the coincidences I've heard fall into that category.
sentences.zh: 我可以说，我听过的大约80%的巧合都属于这一类。

sentences.en: And we'll explore why we are drawn to coincidences,
sentences.zh: 我们还将探讨为什么我们会被巧合吸引，

sentences.en: and what our fascination with them can tell us about the human mind.
sentences.zh: 以及我们对巧合的着迷能向我们揭示关于人类思维的什么秘密。

sentences.en: Whenever you see something that you can't explain, the natural human instinct is to try to understand it.
sentences.zh: 每当你看到无法解释的事情时，人类的自然本能就是试图去理解它。

sentences.en: But that can also mean that sometimes we over-explain things.
sentences.zh: 但这有时也意味着我们会过度解释事物。

sentences.en: We're starting today with a story about Whisper.
sentences.zh: 我们今天从一个关于 Whisper 的故事开始。

sentences.en: And just so you can understand this coincidence story,
sentences.zh: 为了让大家听懂这个巧合的故事，

sentences.en: we're going to first explain what Whisper is and how it works.
sentences.zh: 我们首先要解释一下 Whisper 是什么以及它是如何运作的。

sentences.en: Whisper is an app that allows users to connect anonymously online.
sentences.zh: Whisper 是一个允许用户在网上匿名交流的应用程序。

sentences.en: They can post messages or secrets.
sentences.zh: 他们可以发布消息或秘密。

sentences.en: These are called whispers, and strangers can respond with their own whispers.
sentences.zh: 这些被称为悄悄话（whispers），陌生人可以用他们自己的悄悄话来回应。

sentences.en: We've asked a few producers to read out some of these whispers.
sentences.zh: 我们请了几位制作人来朗读其中一些悄悄话。

sentences.en: I'm secretly planning my wedding on PintereSt.
sentences.zh: 我正在 PintereSt 上秘密筹备我的婚礼。

sentences.en: The messages are short, about the length of a tweet, and they range from the silly...
sentences.zh: 这些消息很短，大约一条推文的长度，内容从滑稽的……

sentences.en: As a teacher, I'm not supposed to have favorites.
sentences.zh: 作为一名老师，我不该有偏爱。

sentences.en: I'm having an abortion on Monday.
Some months ago, the folks at Whisper got in touch to tell us a story
sentences.zh: 几个月前，Whisper 的工作人员联系了我们，给我们讲了一个故事，

sentences.en: about an interesting coincidence that happened on their site.
sentences.zh: 关于发生在他们网站上的一起有趣的巧合。

sentences.en: Lauren Hudson is 27, and she turned to Whisper at one of the darkest moments of her life.
sentences.zh: 劳伦·哈德逊27岁，她在生命中最黑暗的时刻之一求助于 Whisper。

sentences.en: I was in a really bad relationship.
sentences.zh: 我当时身处一段非常糟糕的恋爱关系中。

sentences.en: There was a lot of domestic violence involved.
sentences.zh: 其中涉及大量的家庭暴力。

sentences.en: And I didn't really know what to do or how to reach out to people or how to talk about it.
sentences.zh: 我真的不知道该怎么办，怎么向别人求助，或者怎么谈论这件事。

sentences.en: So I used the app to connect with other women and to kind of vent and, like,
sentences.zh: 所以我用这个应用来和其他女性交流，宣泄一下情绪，还有，

sentences.en: find empowerment to get away from the person that I was with.
sentences.zh: 寻找摆脱身边那个人的力量。

sentences.en: Lauren was having trouble opening up about what was happening with her friends and family.
sentences.zh: 劳伦很难向朋友和家人吐露发生在她身上的事。

sentences.en: I think I was scared, to be completely honeSt.
sentences.zh: 老实说，我想我是害怕的。

sentences.en: I think I had a lot of fear.
And I didn't want, like, any police involved.
sentences.zh: 我不想牵涉进什么警察之类的。

sentences.en: I didn't want it to turn into, like, this whole thing.
sentences.zh: 我不想事情变成那种大动干戈的样子。

sentences.en: But on Whisper, she could be anonymous.
sentences.zh: 但在 Whisper 上，她是匿名的。

sentences.en: She could seek support without all the immediate consequences.
sentences.zh: 她可以在没有直接后果的情况下寻求支持。

sentences.en: It was there, in one of these threads, that she started talking to a man.
sentences.zh: 正是在其中一个讨论串里，她开始和一个男人聊天。

sentences.en: Lauren was touched by how much compassion he seemed to have for her, a complete stranger.
sentences.zh: 劳伦被他表现出的对她——一个完全陌生的人——的同情心所打动。

sentences.en: It was almost as if he genuinely wanted to know how I was.
sentences.zh: 这几乎就像他是真诚地想知道我过得怎么样。

sentences.en: Even though he didn't know who I was, and he knew that it was anonymous,
sentences.zh: 尽管他不知道我是谁，而且他知道这是匿名的，

sentences.en: and who knows who he's talking to, he just genuinely wanted to know if I was okay.
sentences.zh: 谁知道他在和谁说话，但他只是真诚地想知道我是否还好。

sentences.en: He was in a town nearby, another coincidence perhaps, and they started exchanging messages.
sentences.zh: 他在附近的一个镇上，也许又是另一个巧合，他们开始互发消息。

sentences.en: They connected immediately, decided to meet in person.
sentences.zh: 他们一拍即合，决定亲自见面。

sentences.en: We got together, and we went to Applebee's, and we sat and we talked for, like,
sentences.zh: 我们聚在一起，去了苹果蜂餐厅，坐下来聊了，

sentences.en: I think it was, like, almost two hours that we just sat and talked.
sentences.zh: 我想大概有将近两个小时，我们只是坐着聊天。

sentences.en: They became more and more inseparable.
sentences.zh: 他们的关系变得越来越密不可分。

sentences.en: Lauren ended her unhealthy relationship and started dating this guy from Whisper, Eric.
sentences.zh: 劳伦结束了那段不健康的恋情，开始和这个来自 Whisper 的家伙埃里克约会。

sentences.en: But Lauren was a little nervous about meeting Eric's family.
sentences.zh: 但劳伦对见埃里克的家人有点紧张。

sentences.en: Eric had brought Lauren home to have dinner with them, and the whole time, she was anxious.
sentences.zh: 埃里克带劳伦回家和他们共进晚餐，整个过程她都很焦虑。

sentences.en: Like, my palms were sweating, and I felt, like, really hot, you know, so I didn't know if, like,
sentences.zh: 比如，我的手心在出汗，我感觉浑身发热，你知道的，所以我不知道，

sentences.en: if it was going down well or if I was totally blowing it.
sentences.zh: 这进展顺利还是我彻底搞砸了。

sentences.en: Like, I didn't know what was going on.
sentences.zh: 总之，我不知道发生了什么。

sentences.en: She was especially nervous about Eric's sister, Amanda.
sentences.zh: 她对埃里克的姐姐阿曼达尤其感到紧张。

sentences.en: You know, I knew when I first met her there, the first couple times that we hung out and stuff,
sentences.zh: 你知道的，当我在那儿第一次见到她时，前几次我们一起出去玩的时候，

sentences.en: I knew that there was a little bit of a distance there,
sentences.zh: 我知道他们之间有点距离感，

sentences.en: and I knew that every time I went over to, you know, hang out with Eric and his family,
sentences.zh: 我也知道每次我去和埃里克以及他的家人一起玩时，

sentences.en: that those walls would slowly break down.
She and Eric were getting engaged.
sentences.zh: 她和埃里克正准备订婚。
劳伦理解阿曼达的态度。

sentences.en: She felt the same toward the girls her younger brother would bring home.
sentences.zh: 她对她弟弟带回家的女孩也是这种感觉。

sentences.en: Maybe I'll see them next week, you know, or maybe I'll never see them again.
sentences.zh: 也许我下周会见到她们，你知道的，或者也许我再也见不到她们了。

sentences.en: So that was kind of, like, what I had in my head.
sentences.zh: 所以这差不多就是我脑子里想的。

sentences.en: I was like, well, I hope that, you know, I'm thinking,
sentences.zh: 我在想，好吧，我希望，你知道的，我在想，

sentences.en: I hope that they know that I'm not going anywhere.
sentences.zh: 我希望他们知道我哪儿也不去。

sentences.en: She and Eric were getting engaged.
sentences.zh: 她和埃里克正准备订婚。

sentences.en: Eric, in fact, had a flair for the romantic, bringing her roses,
sentences.zh: 事实上，埃里克很有浪漫情调，会给她带玫瑰花，

sentences.en: comforting her with her favorite movie after a tough day.
sentences.zh: 在劳伦经历艰难的一天后，用她最喜欢的电影来安慰她。

sentences.en: And he would tell his family about all this.
sentences.zh: 而且他会把这一切告诉他的家人。

sentences.en: So why couldn't Lauren break through with Amanda?
sentences.zh: 那为什么劳伦无法打破与阿曼达的僵局呢？

sentences.en: All this time, Lauren was still on Whisper.
sentences.zh: 这段时间，劳伦仍然在使用 Whisper。

sentences.en: Now I use it, instead of me looking for help, I use it to help others.
sentences.zh: 现在我用它不是为了寻求帮助，而是用它来帮助别人。

sentences.en: That's my way of giving back, because the Whisper community helped me when I needed them.
sentences.zh: 这是我回馈社会的方式，因为在我需要的时候，Whisper 社区曾帮助过我。

sentences.en: One day, she started exchanging messages with a woman who was going through a very painful breakup.
sentences.zh: 有一天，她开始和一个正在经历痛苦分手的女人互发消息。

sentences.en: I sent a big message, basically saying that it's okay, everyone goes through heartaches,
sentences.zh: 我发了一条很长的消息，大意是没关系的，每个人都会经历心碎，

sentences.en: and there will be many more people out there.
sentences.zh: 外面还会有很多很多的人。

sentences.en: As a way to offer encouragement, Lauren told the woman about her own happy relationship.
sentences.zh: 为了给予鼓励，劳伦向那个女人讲述了她自己幸福的恋爱关系。

sentences.en: The woman asked Lauren about the nicest thing her fiancé had done for her.
sentences.zh: 那个女人问劳伦她的未婚夫为她做过的最贴心的事情是什么。

sentences.en: Lauren told her about the day Eric surprised her with her favorite movie.
sentences.zh: 劳伦向她讲述了埃里克用她最喜欢的电影给她惊喜的那一天。

sentences.en: On my birthday, I had a really bad day at work.
sentences.zh: 在我生日那天，我在工作很不顺。

sentences.en: It was like one of those days where, like, you know, you wake up,
sentences.zh: 那种感觉就像，你知道的，你一醒来，

sentences.en: and just from the moment you put your feet on the floor, like, everything goes wrong.
sentences.zh: 就在你双脚着地的那一刻起，什么都不对劲。

sentences.en: So, I was just, I didn't want to see him that day.
sentences.zh: 所以，我当时就是不想那天见到他。

sentences.en: I just wanted to be home.
Like, I was just, like, I just want to go to bed.
sentences.zh: 我就觉得，我只想去睡觉。

sentences.en: And he surprised me with these beautiful flowers, these roses,
sentences.zh: 而他用美丽的鲜花、玫瑰给了我一个惊喜，

sentences.en: and he had the notebook, which is my favorite, like, sappy love story of all time.
sentences.zh: 他还带来了《恋恋笔记本》，那是我有生以来最喜欢的、带点感伤的爱情故事。

sentences.en: Lauren finished telling her story and waited for a reply.
sentences.zh: 劳伦讲完她的故事，等待着回复。

sentences.en: Her first response after I sent that story to her, she's like, Lauren?
sentences.zh: 在我把那个故事发给她之后，她的第一反应是：劳伦？

sentences.en: I was like, how do you know my name?
sentences.zh: 我说，你怎么知道我的名字？

sentences.en: You know, because it's all anonymous.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，因为这一切都是匿名的。

sentences.en: And she's like, this is Amanda.
Amanda, Eric's sister, the very person she'd been trying so desperately to connect with in real life.
sentences.zh: 阿曼达，埃里克的姐姐，正是她一直拼命想在现实生活中搞好关系的那个人。

sentences.en: Lauren says this coincidence changed her whole relationship with Amanda.
sentences.zh: 劳伦说这个巧合改变了她和阿曼达的整个关系。

sentences.en: Amanda, connecting randomly online and revealing intimate details about themselves
sentences.zh: 阿曼达，在线上随机相遇并透露彼此的亲密细节，

sentences.en: made the two women feel closer.
sentences.zh: 让两个女性感觉更亲近了。

sentences.en: Many of us have experienced these kinds of coincidences.
sentences.zh: 我们许多人都经历过这种巧合。

sentences.en: You bump into your kindergarten friend your first day in college,
sentences.zh: 你在上大学的第一天撞见了幼儿园的朋友，

sentences.en: or you meet someone at a party and discover she lives in your dad's childhood home in Poughkeepsie.
sentences.zh: 或者你在派对上遇到某人，发现她住在你爸爸在波基普西的童年故居里。

sentences.en: When these kinds of coincidences happen in our lives, they feel like magic.
sentences.zh: 当这类巧合发生在我们的生活中时，它们感觉就像魔法一般。

sentences.en: But as any mathematician will tell you,
sentences.zh: 但正如任何数学家都会告诉你的那样，

sentences.en: things that feel unusual or even impossible are actually fairly common.
sentences.zh: 那些感觉不同寻常甚至不可能的事情实际上相当普遍。
数学家约瑟夫·马祖尔深知这一点，

sentences.en: but he was reluctant to write a book that would dispel the magic.
sentences.zh: 但他起初不愿写一本会打破这种神奇感的书。

sentences.en: I don't want to blow the stories in favor of the mathematics
sentences.zh: 我不想为了数学而毁掉这些故事，

sentences.en: because, you know, I was hitting a nerve on coincidences.
sentences.zh: 因为，你知道的，我触及了人们对巧合的敏感神经。

sentences.en: In the end, though, Joseph did write his book.
sentences.zh: 不过最终，约瑟夫还是写了这本书。

sentences.en: It's called Fluke, The Math and Myth of Coincidence.
sentences.zh: 书名叫《偶然：巧合的数学与迷思》。

sentences.en: It's full of stories of people who find themselves experiencing things that feel so unlikely.
sentences.zh: 里面充满了人们发现自己经历着如此不可思议的事情的故事。

sentences.en: But Joseph Mazur says if you study this for a while,
sentences.zh: 但约瑟夫·马祖尔说，如果你研究这个一段时间，

sentences.en: the coincidences start to fall into certain categories.
sentences.zh: 巧合就会开始归入某些类别。

sentences.en: And the stories we heard from our two listeners,
sentences.zh: 我们从两位听众那里听到的故事，

sentences.en: as well as Lauren's story about meeting her soon-to-be sister-in-law on Whisper,
sentences.zh: 以及劳伦在 Whisper 上遇到即将成为自己小姑子的故事，

sentences.en: are all basically the same type of coincidence,
sentences.zh: 基本上都属于同一种类型的巧合，

sentences.en: which in itself is not a coincidence.
sentences.zh: 这本身并不是什么巧合。

sentences.en: If you categorize these coincidences to, let's say, 10 different categories,
sentences.zh: 如果你把这些巧合归纳为，比方说，10个不同的类别，

sentences.en: meeting an acquaintance or somebody you're familiar with,
sentences.zh: 在极其陌生的地方遇到熟人或你熟悉的人，
在一个非常奇怪的地方，

sentences.en: I would say perhaps 80% of all the coincidences I've heard fall into that category.
sentences.zh: 我可以说，我听过的大约80%的巧合都属于那一类。

sentences.en: Joseph Mazur says the reason these coincidences feel extraordinary,
sentences.zh: 约瑟夫·马祖尔说，这些巧合之所以让人感觉非同寻常，

sentences.en: but actually are not so extraordinary,
sentences.zh: 但实际上并没有那么非同寻常，

sentences.en: is because of a common misconception about the number of people we think we actually know.
sentences.zh: 原因在于我们对其实际认识的人数存在一个常见的误解。

sentences.en: People think that their address book is essentially the people they know.
sentences.zh: 人们认为他们的通讯录基本上就是他们认识的人。

sentences.en: And it turns out that any particular address book
sentences.zh: 结果证明，任何特定的通讯录

sentences.en: is about 1% of the people they actually know in some way.
sentences.zh: 大约只占他们实际以某种方式认识的人的 1%。
换句话说，比如一个邻居，

sentences.en: somebody they bump into in the street.
sentences.zh: 一个他们在街上偶遇的人。

sentences.en: But the address book is about 1% of the people they know.
sentences.zh: 但通讯录里的人只占他们认识的人的大约 1%。

sentences.en: As a result, the odds of bumping into someone you know
are much greater than you think,
because you know many more people than you think.
sentences.zh: 因为你认识的人比你想象的要多得多。

sentences.en: Sometimes math can help us understand the magic.
sentences.zh: 有时数学可以帮助我们理解这种奇迹。
比如赢得彩票这样的奇迹，

sentences.en: not just once, but several times.
sentences.zh: 而且不仅是一次，而是好几次。

sentences.en: That's what happened to a woman named Joan Ginther.
sentences.zh: 这就是一个名叫琼·金瑟（Joan Ginther）的女人身上发生的事。

sentences.en: she won $5.4 million in Texas lotto.
sentences.zh: 她赢得了 540 万美元的德克萨斯州彩票。

sentences.en: 13 years later, she won again $2 million.
sentences.zh: 13 年后，她又赢了 200 万美元。

sentences.en: And then a few years after that,
And then in 2010, she won $10 million.
sentences.zh: 接着在 2010 年，她赢了 1000 万美元。

sentences.en: What are the odds of one person winning the lottery four times?
sentences.zh: 一个人四次中彩票的几率是多少？

sentences.en: I think somebody made a calculation,
that the odds are about 18 septillion to one
sentences.zh: 发生的几率大约是 18 万京分之一

sentences.en: For those who are not mathematicians,
sentences.zh: 对于那些不懂数学的人来说，

sentences.en: mathematicians, a septillion is one followed by 24 zeros.
sentences.zh: 一个“京”（septillion）就是 1 后面有 24 个零。
但约瑟夫·马祖尔（Joseph Mazur）说，

sentences.en: we're actually asking the wrong question.
sentences.zh: 我们实际上问错了问题。

sentences.en: If I buy a lottery ticket,
what are the odds that I will win?
